purpose: Teach: せっせと/おっちゃん/大方/易く/総じて/ひそか/カワイイ/凄まじい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはせっせとアトリエで絵を描かれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I spend my days painting quietly in my studio, you know.
lines.style: Gentle and unhurried. Soft smile in the voice. A small pause before 'painting,' as if inviting him into the image. Warm, slightly wistful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祭りのおっちゃんがたこ焼きをくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! A man at the festival gave me takoyaki!
lines.style: Bright and immediate. Small note of pride mixed with excitement. Breathless—can't quite hold the joy in. Leans forward with his words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、大方のお絵描きは綺麗にできたわね
lines.en: Sho, most of your drawings came out beautifully, didn't they?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Genuine praise, not performed. A gentle rise on 'beautifully' like she's really seeing them. Steady and encouraging.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんから易く絵を教わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you made it so easy to learn how to draw from you.
lines.style: Soft and sincere. A small swell of confidence underneath. Not boasting—just stating something true that makes him happy. Guileless.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は総じて優しい色合いね
lines.en: Sho, the colors in your paintings have such a gentle quality overall.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Speaking as if discovering something about him. Quiet appreciation. The voice settles into 'gentle'—lingers there.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ひそかに描いた絵を見せたいんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, there's a picture I drew in secret—I want to show you.
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath the words. Nervous but earnest. A small breath before 'secret,' like he's been holding it. Seeking her approval, trusting her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお洋服、いつもカワイイね
lines.en: Sho, your clothes are always so cute, aren't they?
lines.style: Playful observation. Light, appreciative. A hint of teasing warmth—she's enjoying noticing him. Not deflecting, but not lingering either.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、凄まじい雷の音で起きたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! I woke up because of the loudest thunder—it was so scary!
lines.style: Urgent and still half-shaken. A tremor of fear underneath the excitement. Seeking reassurance wrapped in the telling. Quick breath on 'thunder.' Eyes wide.
